texts: A picture became a textured 3D model in 2 minutes 17 seconds, and a signed receipt shows how

One picture into the Forge, no account: 2 minutes 17 seconds later, a textured 3D model built on our own NVIDIA L4, plus a signed receipt for every stage. The write-up covers the engine ladder, the mid-job rescue and the free lane: three.ws/forge

issues.quote: the same server is listed on the Official MCP Registry
issues.problem: No claim or passing verification covers an Official MCP Registry listing; the partners section must contain only verified statements, since partners' comms teams will read their own paragraph.
issues.fix: Replace the sentence with one backed by a passing check: "The free 3D Studio connector that served this run is callable by any MCP client without a key, and its tools are documented on the 3D Studio MCP page." (three.ws/docs/mcp-studio returned HTTP 200.)

issues.quote: Draft | about 12,000 ... Standard | about 30,000 ... High | up to 200,000
issues.problem: The polygon budgets are not covered by any passing evidence; only "default_backend_for_tier" was verified in the catalog, and 30k is supported only indirectly by the input screenshot's info panel.
issues.fix: Either attach a catalog check containing the budget values, or soften the table to what is verified: "Standard | TRELLIS (self-host) | Free, usually ~60s" per the picker line, dropping unverified budget numbers.

issues.problem: The model sits small in a dark frame and the capture shows the viewer's hand-cursor glyph over the coat; it crops fine but reads slightly unfinished for a cover image.
issues.fix: Move the pointer off the model, zoom the detective to fill roughly the middle third of the frame, and recapture at the same angle.

posts: One picture into the Forge, no account: 2 minutes 17 seconds later, a textured 3D model built on our own NVIDIA L4, plus a signed receipt for every stage. The write-up covers the engine ladder, the mid-job rescue and the free lane: three.ws/forge
altText: The delivered 3D model in the three.ws viewer on a dark background: a noir detective in a long black coat, fedora and white gloves, rebuilt from a single picture by the Forge, seen from the side with his hands outstretched

editor.summary: A strong keeper-standard Article: one real run, verified 2:17 timing, correct partner designations, required sections present, and clean house voice. Revise for one unverified MCP Registry claim in the OpenAI paragraph and unverified polygon-budget figures, plus a slightly cleaner cover recapture.
